_about: What each prize paid, by season. Hand-recorded from the RS57 sheet, one tab per season.
Prize money is league-specific and appears NOWHERE in ESPN, so this sheet is the only
source for it. There is no second witness to fall back on, which is why this file is
Amounts are per-season, NOT constants. 2023 paid Survivor $50 where 2025 pays $40.
Resist hard-coding a dollar figure anywhere in the code.
Human-owned, like everything in data/manual/. The nightly Action READS this and must
'stud' is per position and pays four times (QB/RB/WR/TE). 'weekly_high' is per week and
pays once for each of the 14 regular-season weeks. Both totals are checked against the
sheet's own column footer by stats.award_prizes.

2023: 2023 is deliberately absent. It paid Survivor $50 and each weekly high score $9.29 —
a one-off from the season the NFL went to 18 weeks and the pot was divided across the
extra weeks. The league has since gone back to whole dollars.
$9.29 is not an integer, and all money in this repo is integer dollars, so Payout
cannot represent it. Widening the model to floats to carry one retired edge case would
put floats into every salary in the league. 2023 is a backfill problem for a later
phase; its 2023 stats still compute, it just gets no payout rows.
